figures.caption: Figure 1: TDAD overview. Blue boxes are LLM coding agents; gray boxes are deterministic measurement or infrastructure. TestSmith, PromptSmith, and the Compiled Agent form the compilation pipeline (left). MutationSmith operates post-compilation for evaluation only (right). Spec evolution (bottom) measures regression safety across versions.
Table 6: Selected Mutation Testing Results (K=Killed, S=Survived). Each spec has 5–7 total intents; the 4 most representative per spec are shown.
Figure 2: Semantic mutation testing pipeline. Mutants that fail activation after 5 attempts are excluded as non-activating, analogous to filtering likely-equivalent mutants in traditional frameworks.
